static_traits.name: 陈文俊
static_traits.family_status: Has an older sister; usually enjoys cooking for family and friends
static_traits.social_status: 有人际支持（家人和朋友可倾诉），但尚not yet与他们讨论这些具体感受；因自卑感而影响与家人朋友的关系
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；既往without类似心理问题；never接受过心理治疗或咨询
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑性较好、配合度高；能进行自我Reflection；情绪总体稳定但略紧张；愿意尝试练习和记录

basic_info.main_problem: 我仍然爱着前Male友，并且在烹饪方面感到自我not足。自卑感始于姐姐的婚礼她请了外部餐饮而not是让我来做，这之后问题加重；当给他人做饭或遇到与食物相关的活动时尤为明显。
basic_info.core_demands: I realize these feelings of inferiority are affecting my self-esteem and mental health, and therefore come to seek counseling; I want to overcome this feeling, enjoy cooking again as before, and change my negative thinking patterns.
growth_experiences: 在姐姐的婚礼上，姐姐选择雇佣专业餐饮而非让自己承办；此后在烹饪方面产生强烈的自我not足与比较心理，逐渐加重。此前，自己常为家人朋友做饭并获得赞美与认可，但婚礼事件后开始二次猜测、not断Self-denial，将姐姐的选择解读为“I am not good enough/水平达not到大型场合要求”。
与前Male友分手后，仍然对其抱有情感依恋（“仍然爱着前Male友”），这一not yet了的关系体验与Impaired self-esteem相互交织。

core_beliefs: I am not good enough（not够有能力）
My worth depends on my performance in front of others (especially cooking)

special_situations.event: 姐姐婚礼时选择雇佣专业餐饮而not是让我来做
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果家人not选择我来承担重要场合的烹饪，就证明I am not good enough/not合格
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避为他人做饭、沉溺Self-doubt与自我批评
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 她not让我做是因为我not行，我让家人失望了

special_situations.event: 在为他人做饭之前Anticipation可能被评价或出错
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要出现任何差错就证明I am a terrible cook
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 尽量Avoids cooking场合，以避免可能的失败与批评
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will mess up; something will definitely go wrong

special_situations.event: 在烹饪过程中not断关注可能的瑕疵与问题
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Must be perfect to count as qualified, otherwise it is failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 过度Self-monitoring与反复negate已完成的步骤，难以认可当下表现
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这道菜not够好，without论我怎么做都not达标

special_situations.event: After receiving praise and affirmation from others
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 他人的正面反馈并not可靠，真正有效的只有批评
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate正向反馈，将称赞归因为“客套”，以防止期望被打破
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们只是客气，其实我并not行

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be affirmed through cooking skills by family and significant others, to be appreciated and needed
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被negate、被评判为“not够好”，由此感到羞耻与Being rejected
defense_goal: 通过回避被评价的场合与negate正向反馈来减少Anxiety与羞耻感

object_relations.self_representation: not够格、随时会出错的提供者/Chef
object_relations.object_representation: Picky judgers (such as family / others / professionals)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当讨论姐姐婚礼及其选择，或被询问他人为何not让自己承办时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将他人的选择解读为对自己能力的negate（将内在羞耻Projection为“他们觉得我not行”）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 用肯定语气坚持“他们看低我/not信任我”，use绝对化词语，忽视替代性解释。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others give positive feedback and affirmation
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为赞美只是出于礼貌，not能反映真实能力
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responds to praise in a flat or even downplaying tone, attributing it to 'politeness / courtesy', downplaying emotional engagement.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to cook for others or facing situations where one may be evaluated
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 把潜在失误视为会“证明自己一without是处”的威胁
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Politely declines or finds objective reasons to avoid tasks, cautious tone, showing little emotion.

manifestations: 虽有家人和朋友的支持，但not yet与他们讨论具体的自卑与困扰
与前Male友分手后仍然深陷情感牵挂，体验到关系层面的落差与Loneliness
outcomes: Avoids cooking与评价场景，减少与他人的真实接触

manifestations: Treats the inner requirement that 'it must be perfect to count as qualified' as a guideline, restricting their choices in cooking and socializing
outcomes: Increased behavioral avoidance、体验容许度降低
Hard to spontaneously enjoy cooking and interpersonal interaction

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 在厨房里not断Self-doubt与过度检查，use“I am not good enough”的内在独白
Worries about being evaluated and is overly cautious, reducing direct contact with others

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: 把姐姐雇佣外部餐饮解读为对自己能力的negate
Views others' praise as 'politeness', finding it hard to internalize positive feedback

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths.
manifestations: Holds the implicit rule 'on important occasions it must be done perfectly by me to count as qualified'
Demanding of oneself with 'should/must' standards to reach a professional level at large events

positive_force: Has long cooked for family and friends and gained affirmation, possessing actual cooking ability and successful experience
有家人和朋友可提供支持（尽管尚not yet谈及具体困扰）
工作稳定，not yet受明显影响，生活结构相对稳定
Positive attitude, willing to challenge negative thinking through recording and behavioral experiments
negative_force: Tends toward social comparison and resulting inferiority
negate正向反馈、过度关注负面信息（心理过滤）
在面临评价时回避与Withdrawal，减少实践机会
与前Male友的not yet了情感牵绊影响自我价值感

target_behavior.behavior: 回避Cooking for others（尽量not在社交场合下做饭）
antecedent: Being invited or having the chance to cook for others
Activities or topics related to food/banquets appear
target_behavior.core_reason: 将姐姐婚礼的选择内化为Self-denial，并以完美主义标准看待表现，担心任何失误就证明自己“一without是处”
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在的负面评价与失败，短期缓解Anxiety与羞耻
target_behavior.consequence: Interaction with family and friends is limited, self-esteem keeps being damaged, hard to enjoy cooking again

target_behavior.behavior: negate正向反馈（将称赞解释为客套）
antecedent: Receives others' praise and positive evaluations after cooking
target_behavior.core_reason: 为维持“I am not good enough”的核心信念并避免日后被negate的打击，倾向以“客套”来Rationalization赞美
target_behavior.consequence: 难以内化积极经验，ReinforcementSelf-doubt and low self-esteem，维持消极认知循环
